title: Attainment of the nodal Nehari infimum: existence of a least energy sign-changing solution of a Schrodinger system by a four-dimensional Nehari deformation
author: Anna Lisa Amadori
work: On nodal ground states for Schrodinger systems
source_version: Electronic Journal of Differential Equations 2026, No. 08, pp. 1--18; DOI 10.58997/ejde.2026.08; publisher version
difficulty_reason: The counted theorem is the existence half of the main characterization of nodal least energy solutions. After the variational setting, the nodal Nehari manifold and the geometric Lemmas 3.1-3.4 are supplied, the proof still has to control a minimizing sequence on a constraint of codimension four: it must show that the weak limit stays in the set where the nodal and the sign-changing Nehari sets coincide, which requires comparing the nodal level with the decoupled Nehari levels, and then, separately for q equal to 2 and for q larger than 2, construct a four-parameter family that is driven back into the nodal Nehari set, using the two theta-maximisation propositions and the Miranda theorem to produce the sign configuration, and finally derive from the strict decrease of the energy the contradiction that forces the deformation parameter to vanish and the limit to solve the system. This constrained minimax argument with an explicit four-dimensional deformation is research level, not a qualification exercise.
